# Dr. Dental NM

> > Comprehensive family and cosmetic dental practice in Albuquerque, NM offering emergency care, implants, orthodontics, and pediatric services with Medicaid acceptance.

Dr. Dental NM is a full-service dental practice in Albuquerque led by Dr. Suneel Namburi and Dr. Kranti Bellam, providing preventive, restorative, cosmetic, and surgical dental services. The practice emphasizes patient accessibility through online scheduling, registration forms, and emergency same-day treatment.

## Core Services & Specialties

- [General Dentistry](https://www.drdentalnm.com/general-dentistry-albuquerque-nm): General dentistry services including cleanings, hygiene, and gum disease prevention
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://www.drdentalnm.com/emergency-dental-care-albuquerque-nm): Emergency dental care services with same-day treatment for Albuquerque patients
- [Oral Surgery & Extractions](https://www.drdentalnm.com/oral-surgery): Oral surgery services including tooth extractions and wisdom teeth removal
- [Root Canals & Endodontics](https://www.drdentalnm.com/root-canals-endodontics-albuquerque-nm): Root canal and endodontic treatment to repair infected or damaged teeth

## Restorative & Cosmetic Dentistry

- [Dental Implants](https://www.drdentalnm.com/dental-implants-albuquerque-nm): Dental implant placement for tooth replacement and restoration
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.drdentalnm.com/cosmetic-dentistry-in-albuquerque-nm): Cosmetic dentistry with veneers, bonding, and composite resin restorations
- [Crowns & Bridges](https://www.drdentalnm.com/crowns-bridges): Dental crowns and bridges in porcelain and gold for tooth restoration
- [Dentures & Partial Dentures](https://www.drdentalnm.com/dentures-partial-dentures): Complete and partial dentures for missing tooth replacement and restoration
- [Tooth Whitening](https://www.drdentalnm.com/tooth-whitening-albuquerque-nm): Professional tooth whitening using hydrogen and carbamide peroxide treatments

## Specialized Treatment Options

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.drdentalnm.com/childrens-dentistry-2): Pediatric dental care for children including preventive and infant oral health
- [Orthodontics & Clear Aligners](https://www.drdentalnm.com/orthodonticsclear-aligners): Clear aligner orthodontic treatment for teeth straightening
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.drdentalnm.com/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry options including nitrous oxide and general anesthesia
